subject: POC: Success criteria, timeline & risk tracker for FintechCo trial
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom@fintechco.com>, Anika Shah <anika@fintechco.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: Discovery + proposed POC success criteria / next steps

Thanks Tom & Anika — great call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC so we have shared expectations.

Key outcomes from today's call:
- FintechCo wants to validate: 1) latency under peak load for autocomplete workflows, 2) semantic search relevancy on internal docs, and 3) end-to-end cost per 1k requests.
- Scope: 2-week trial against a 5M-document index and a simulated peak of 50 RPS.
- Data: you will provide a redacted sample dataset + API access to the search endpoint.

Proposed success criteria (attached):
- Avg tail latency (p95) < 200ms on 50 RPS sustained
- Search MAP@10 >= 0.35 on provided evaluation set
- End-to-end cost under $X per 1k requests (TBD in shared sheet)

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize success criteria + sign mutual action plan
- Week 1: infra & sandbox access, baseline runs
- Week 2: tuning and final eval, handoff to FintechCo stakeholders

Owners / escalation:
- Redwood SE: Dev Patel (tech lead, contact for infra/bugs)
- Commercial / deal owner: me (Marissa)
- Escalations: Marcus Lin (manager) for SLA/contract exceptions

I've attached a draft success-criteria spreadsheet and a POC risk tracker CSV (starter). Please review and flag changes. If this looks good, can we lock the kickoff for Tue 2026-07-28?

Attachments: FintechCo_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (xlsx), POC_Risk_Tracker.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Note: internal recipients — please review the risk tracker and add any known mitigations for the items in the "initial risks" tab.

From: Tom Reynolds <tom@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Anika Shah <anika@fintechco.com>, FintechCo POC Team <poc@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + proposed POC success criteria / next steps

Thanks Marissa — that matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:
- For the cost target, we'll confirm an acceptable threshold by Friday; can you include estimated token counts in the cost tab?
- We'll provide a redacted dataset by Monday (7/26) and need sandbox credentials.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood supports IP allowlisting for the sandbox? It's a must for our security team.

Kickoff Tue 7/28 works for us as long as network access is confirmed.

Tom
CTO, FintechCo

On Tue, Jul 20, 2026 at 9:15 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> (original message)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + proposed POC success criteria / next steps

Thanks for the summary — adding a few technical notes and mitigation proposals (internal + external).

Technical notes:
- IP allowlisting: supported on sandbox. I'll send the network-checklist.pdf (attachment) with the IP ranges and ports.
- Data ingestion: we can run an initial ingest job in <24h once we have the redacted sample. For the 5M-doc target we'll need a short warmup window.
- Load testing: we'll use our continuous batching mode for the search workloads and run 50 RPS sustained for 10 minutes to capture p95.

Known risks & mitigations (outline for the tracker):
1) Risk: Ingest pipeline fails on some docs (format edge cases).
   Mitigation: Pre-ingest validation script + fallback ingest path; SE to triage within 24h. Owner: Dev Patel.
2) Risk: Network egress restrictions block sandbox access.
   Mitigation: IP allowlist + shared lighthouse endpoint; run a connectivity smoke test before kickoff. Owner: Dev Patel.
3) Risk: Model quality gap on semantic search for domain-specific terms.
   Mitigation: Quick prompt/template tuning, and fall back to reranker variant. Owner: Redwood SE (Dev) + FintechCo SME.
4) Risk: Blocking bug during baseline run (inference runtime crash).
   Mitigation: Hotfix branch + roll-forward plan; Marcus to approve priority SLA for fixes. Escalation path: if issue >4 hrs, Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwood.com) -> Eng on-call.

I'll attach the network checklist and a short runbook for triage.

Attachment: network-checklist.pdf

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom@fintechco.com>, Anika Shah <anika@fintechco.com>

Subject: POC kickoff logistics and mutual action plan (MAP)

Tom / Anika — thanks for the quick replies. We're updating the success-criteria sheet with token estimates and a finalized cost row; see link below.

Proposed kickoff: Tue 2026-07-28 09:00 PT — agenda: infra checks, ingest job, baseline runs, and define handoff criteria. Please confirm attendees.

Mutual action plan & DocuSign:
- I've uploaded a short MAP for signature. Link: https://www.docusign.com/mutual-action-plan/8721
- Please sign by 7/24 to keep the timeline.

Escalation & blocking issues (explicit):
- Day-of-blocker (runtime crash, data loss): Contact Dev Patel (SE) immediately; if unresolved >4 hours, escalate to Marcus Lin for priority engineering allocation.
- Security/data concerns: Laura Bennett (Redwood Security Liaison) is cc'd — she'll coordinate any evidence/SOC2 artifacts.

Next steps for FintechCo:
- Provide redacted sample dataset (by 7/26)
- Confirm IPs for allowlisting (Dev will send format)
- Sign MAP (by 7/24)

Next steps for Redwood:
- Prep sandbox and share credentials (Dev)
- Pre-ingest validation and baseline plan (Dev)
- Fill cost estimates in sheet (Marissa)

Attachments: updated FintechCo_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.
Marissa
